name: modgud-root
description: Root scripts for building the SPA + end-user docs directly into the backend's wwwroot.

scripts.build:frontend: cd src/frontend-vue && pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm exec vite build --outDir ../dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:userdocs: cd userdocs && pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm exec vitepress build --outDir ../src/dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot/docs
scripts.build:backend: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:userdocs
scripts.watch:frontend: cd src/frontend-vue && pnpm exec vite build --outDir ../dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot --emptyOutDir --watch
